presets.label: Remove Unwanted Objects
presets.prompt: Remove the unwanted object described below and reconstruct the background naturally. Preserve everything else.

presets.label: Replace the Background
presets.prompt: Replace the background as described below. Preserve the subject, edges, lighting consistency and identity.

presets.label: Professional Headshot
presets.prompt: Create a natural professional headshot of the same person, with flattering studio light and a clean background.

presets.label: Restore an Old Photo
presets.prompt: Repair scratches, fading and damage, recover natural detail, and retain the original subjects and composition.

presets.label: Remove the Background
presets.prompt: Isolate the subject on a clean plain studio backdrop. Preserve fine edges and subject details.

presets.label: Enhance Image Detail
presets.prompt: Improve clarity and natural detail without changing the scene or introducing new objects.

presets.label: Retouch a Portrait
presets.prompt: Subtly retouch small blemishes and distractions while retaining natural skin texture and the same identity.

presets.label: Edit Text in an Image
presets.prompt: Replace the wording as described below while preserving the typography, layout, surface and perspective.

presets.label: Mirror Selfie Composition
presets.prompt: Recompose the same person as a natural mirror selfie with plausible reflection and perspective.

presets.label: Studio Portrait
presets.prompt: Create an editorial studio portrait of the same person with professional lighting and natural proportions.

presets.label: Outfit Change
presets.prompt: Change the clothing as described below without changing the person or the setting.

presets.label: Expression & Pose
presets.prompt: Give the same person a relaxed confident pose and a natural friendly expression.

presets.label: Athletic Portrait
presets.prompt: Create a natural healthy athletic portrait of the same adult, preserving identity and realistic proportions.
